prereg_commit_note: PHASE18_PREREG.md was not yet committed when this ran (Gowtham asked for unattended execution; he commits his own work). prereg_blob_sha is the git content hash of the spec at run time; once committed, `git log --find-object=<blob>` recovers the commit.

method.lab_flow: mean over shared temperatures of sign(yield_a,T - yield_b,T)
method.comparator_flow: mean over shared, both-gate-passing temperatures of compare() margin
method.hodge: weighted LS potential, w = #temperatures in the comparator flow
method.bootstrap: 10000 node (recipe) resamples, rho fixed at full-graph value

P_18B_1.statement: AUC of rho for predicting comparator-lab disagreement > 0.5, CI excluding 0.5, beating the permutation null at p < 0.05.

E_astral.reason: ASTRAL measured two recipes per target; each target gives one edge, the pooled graph is a forest with no cycles, every Hodge residual is 0 and the AUC is undefined.
